About neon1

A one-person technology practice in New York that leaves people better off with their tech than they were before.

Type
Page
Edition
1.1
First written
September 7, 2025
Updated
November 9, 2026

I'm Pradeep. I've worked with technology and automation for about 15 years, at home and at work. neon1 is how I do that work for local businesses, teams, and families, so they end up better off with their tech than before.

How I work:

  • I listen before I build.
  • You get your options, even if that's all you need.
  • It stays as simple as the problem allows.
  • Your accounts, data, and documentation stay yours.
  • Costs are explained before work starts.
  • I plan for failure and test that the work does what we agreed.

neon1 is the name neon1 LLC, a New York company, does business under. See the names for where it comes from, and contact to get in touch.
